audit: Fang et al. 2011 ROCK2 HTRF source acquisition and assay audit

primary_source.title: Synthesis and biological evaluation of 4-quinazolinones as Rho kinase inhibitors
primary_source.citation: Fang X et al., Bioorganic & Medicinal Chemistry Letters 21(6), 1844-1848 (2011)
primary_source.scope_from_public_metadata: The article reports 4-quinazolinone/quinazoline ROCK-II inhibitors and SAR/selectivity over PKA.

attempted_public_locations.result: publisher landing page accessible only as metadata/abstract; article download endpoint returned HTTP 403
institutional repository record with citation and abstract metadata; no downloadable article or SI exposed
Europe PMC record reports not open access, not in PMC, and no PDF/full text
OpenAlex metadata has no PDF URL; the repository location is a BindingDB dataset record rather than the article

acquisition_search.search_boundary: Searched publisher, Europe PMC, OpenAlex, and an institutional author-affiliation repository record. No credentials, outreach, or bulk/fulltext scraping used.

chembl1686688_record_audit.description: Inhibition of ROCK2 by HTRF assay
chembl1686688_record_audit.target_assignment: homologous single protein target assigned; confidence score 8 in archived ChEMBL record
chembl1686688_record_audit.identity_mapping: ChEMBL supplies molecule IDs and canonical SMILES for all 35 records. A primary Table/compound-number mapping cannot be claimed because the article/SI was not obtained.
chembl1686688_record_audit.record_quality: Preserve all censoring relations; do not treat <1 nM or >5000 nM as exact values.

readout.value: HTRF is stated in the ChEMBL assay description

eligibility_decision.reason: ChEMBL annotates ROCK2 HTRF IC50 and assigns the human target homologue (confidence8); actual assay species, construct, ATP and primary compound/table mapping remain unverified without primary text.
eligibility_decision.safe_use: May be retained as a secondary-source candidate or sensitivity analysis with explicit unresolved method fields and censored labels.
eligibility_decision.strict_independent_test: Requires primary full text/SI or an authoritative protocol and a compound-by-compound reconciliation before use as a strict independent assay benchmark.

limitations: BindingDB DataCite metadata identifies the related article and describes protein Rho-associated kinase with UniProt O75116, but it is a data repository record and does not substitute for the primary assay protocol.
The publisher abstract supports ROCK-II inhibitor study scope but reports no construct, ATP concentration, or table values in the accessible metadata.
No inference from numerical agreement or ChEMBL canonical SMILES was used to assign article compound numbers.
